requirements.title: Identifier scope depends on identifier class and excludes shadowed nested scopes
requirements.definition: A global identifier has program scope, a local identifier has inclusive scope, a construct-entity identifier has construct scope, and a statement-entity identifier has statement or part-statement scope, excluding nested scopes that treat the identifier as another entity or make it inaccessible by IMPORT.

pending.global-identifier-program-scope: Source-use plan: pair a program-unit or external-procedure global identifier with a local homonym control under 19.3.1 so the global/local boundary, not ordinary lookup, owns the contrast.
pending.local-identifier-inclusive-scope: Plan a host local integer name with an internal subprogram reference, then a nested local homonym that leaves the host sentinel unchanged, proving inclusive scope and nested exclusion are both load-bearing.
pending.construct-identifier-construct-scope: Runtime plan delegates values to 19.4: preload outer i=99, execute DO CONCURRENT (i=1:3) writing distinct array elements, and assert outer i remains 99 after END DO.
pending.statement-identifier-statement-scope: Runtime plan delegates values to 19.4: preload outer i=99, evaluate [(i, i=1,3)] expecting [1,2,3], and assert outer i remains 99 after the statement.
pending.nested-scope-shadowing-exclusion: Use outer and inner same-spelling variables with values 41 and 73; assert the inner reference observes 73 and a later outer reference still observes 41.
pending.import-inaccessibility-exclusion: Source-use plan for IMPORT boundaries under 8.8; retain IMPORT inaccessibility here without adding a duplicate IMPORT diagnostic.

requirements.title: Entities may be identified by the listed identifier forms
requirements.definition: An entity may be identified by an image index, name, statement label, external input/output unit number, pending data transfer identifier, submodule identifier, generic identifier, or binding label.

pending.image-index-identifier-form: Out of scope by user decision for image/coarray facets; keep future single-image tests from treating image indexes as ordinary names.
pending.name-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/names.json for name lexical rules; the local/global ownership contrast is supplied by this packet's concrete S19.1 and S19.2 plans.
pending.statement-label-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/labels.json for statement labels; no duplicate label diagnostic is created here.
pending.external-unit-number-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/units_12_5_1.json for external input/output unit numbers; do not assert processor-dependent unit-number choices.
pending.pending-data-transfer-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/id_specifier_12_6_2_9.json for pending data-transfer identifiers before any WAIT/ID assertion.
pending.submodule-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/submodules_14_2_3.json for submodule identifiers; do not duplicate submodule syntax checks.
pending.generic-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owners doc/catalogues/generic_identifiers_15_4_3_4_1.json and doc/catalogues/resolving_generic_procedure_references_15_5_5_2.json for generic identifiers and resolution; future name-resolution fixtures use exact sentinels.
pending.binding-label-identifier-form: Source-use plan names existing owner doc/catalogues/bind_attribute_data_entities_8_5_5.json for binding labels and this catalogue S19.2-003 for global uniqueness.

requirements.title: Association can preserve or change identifiers across and within scopes
requirements.definition: By association, an entity can be referred to by the same identifier or a different identifier in a different scope, or by a different identifier in the same scope.

pending.same-identifier-different-scope-associat: Plan a host-associated variable with value 37 and an internal procedure reading the same spelling; assert the inner value is 37 after a nondefault host initialization.
pending.different-identifier-different-scope-ass: Plan a USE rename with module variable source_name=52 and local use name local_name; assert local_name reads 52 while source_name is not referenced in the user scope.
pending.different-identifier-same-scope-associat: Source-use plan for pointer/procedure association and generic identifiers; require the owning association rule to supply the executable effect.
